title: Mechanical Sovereignty: The 740 Project
concept: Resilience through reduced dependencies, repairability as design principle, mechanical sovereignty as doctrine.
project_context: Volvo 740 Combi sleeper build with mechanical-first philosophy: stock exterior concealing hidden engineering (Saab B204/B234 turbo, M90 gearbox, reinforced chassis).
review_reason: High-quality doctrine artifact combining vehicle engineering with B1C3 systems-thinking principles. Requires review for positioning as preparedness literacy vs. survival/emergency framing.
notes: Mature project with full chat history, generation strategy, and visual assets. Doctrine developed through iterative refinement.
key_footer: What you can repair, you can trust.
